name: Shiraide Tooko
source:
Specialty: Koto, Ikebana
Hobby: Wandering around Ginza
Likes: Zoo
Dislikes: Her lessons

A sole daughter of an old-established family, Shiraide. A young lady who lacks of worldly sense. A student at capital's distinguished all-girls school, she also leads her daily lives at her mansion with Melissa and the other maids. One of Chief's best-paying clients.

"Yes, I want you to find this rare item. I don't mind paying much as a reward."
